title: FancyTech Closes Pre-A (GSR) and Series A (Yuanshu + GSR/Huashan) — Unique Capital Advises
summary: FancyTech (时代涌现) — AI + content big data + aesthetic quantification — closed GSR Ventures Pre-A early 2022, then Series A in Nov 2022 led by Yuanshu Capital with GSR and Huashan Capital following. Unique Capital advised the A round. Proceeds: R&D, product, team.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · February 15, 2023

FancyTech (时代涌现) — AI + content big data + aesthetic quantification — closed GSR Ventures Pre-A early 2022, then Series A in Nov 2022 led by Yuanshu Capital with GSR and Huashan Capital following. Unique Capital advised the A round. Proceeds: R&D, product, team.

2022 AIGC waves: AI paint then AI chat — video still lacks a breakout hit. GSR Zhu Xiaohu: AIGC helps firms understand big data and run smarter ops. CEO William: learn cross-platform content → own models → generate more from merchant assets. Post-angel Content Hub: “smart reuse of cross-platform hits + smart content gen” to lift brand SKU conversion and retention. Single-platform traffic capped → multi-platform content intelligence.

— END —
